entries.name: Ashvein Goblinkin
entries.text:
Ashvein Goblinkin: Dark skirmishers, ranks F–S.

Goblins whose dormant GKOM woke in the ash of burned camps. They hoard crystal chips like coin; the more crystal they swallow, the larger and more organised they become, until a warlord commands whole warbands.

Material: Ash-black goblin hide. Found in: ruin, mine, edge, briar.

Forms:
• Ashvein Goblin Scavenger (F–E): Only a few smoky crystals betray the corruption beneath its skin. Moves: Crystal Shiv, Shard Flick. Drops: F-rank Death Crystal, Ash-black goblin hide, GKOM Dust. Evolves into Ashvein Hobgoblin.
• Ashvein Hobgoblin (D–C): Drilled and armoured, it fights in a shield line and never alone. Moves: Crystal Shiv, Shard Flick, War Drum. Drops: D-rank Death Crystal, Ash-black goblin hide, GKOM Dust. Evolves into Ashvein Bugbrute.
• Ashvein Bugbrute (B): A hulking ambusher that drags prey into the dark by the ankle. Moves: Crystal Shiv, Shard Flick, War Drum, Brute Haul. Drops: B-rank Death Crystal, Ash-black goblin hide, Refined GKOM Essence. Evolves into Ashvein Warlord.
• Ashvein Warlord (A–S): Crowned in grey quartz, it speaks for every goblin in the valley. Moves: Crystal Shiv, Shard Flick, War Drum, Brute Haul, Warband Volley. Drops: A-rank Death Crystal, Ash-black goblin hide, Refined GKOM Essence.

entries.text:
Obsidian Talons: Fire skirmishers, ranks E–S.

Raptors whose feathers harden to obsidian blades. The greatest of them circle the old bridge on wings of fire.

Material: Obsidian feather. Found in: ruin, keep, blight, mine.

• Ash Thunderbird (S): A firestorm with wings, its crystal plumage glowing white-hot. Moves: Talon Rake, Obsidian Dive, Feather Storm, Sky Drop. Drops: S-rank Death Crystal, Obsidian feather, Refined GKOM Essence.

entries.name: Prism Wardens
entries.text:
Prism Wardens: Light casters, ranks F–A.

Lights that once guarded the moon shrine. GKOM bent their purpose: they still guard, but now they guard the corruption.

Material: Prism shard. Found in: ruin, heartwood, keep, marsh.

Forms:
• Prism Wisp (F–E): A floating mote of green light that leads travellers astray. Moves: Prism Bolt, Verdant Mend, Prism Ward. Drops: F-rank Death Crystal, Prism shard, GKOM Dust. Evolves into Viridian Prism Warden.
• Prism Warden (D–C): A faceted sentinel that heals its allies with light. Moves: Prism Bolt, Verdant Mend, Prism Ward. Drops: D-rank Death Crystal, Prism shard, GKOM Dust. Evolves into Prism Archon.
• Prism Archon (B–A): A crown of rotating prisms judging everything that enters. Moves: Prism Bolt, Verdant Mend, Prism Ward, Refraction. Drops: B-rank Death Crystal, Prism shard, Refined GKOM Essence.

entries.name: Cobalt Burrowers
entries.text:
Cobalt Burrowers: Earth guardians, ranks E–S (large).

Armoured worms that eat ore and excrete cobalt crystal. Miners know the tremor that means one is passing below.

Material: Cobalt shell. Found in: cave, mine, crystal, keep.

Forms:

• Cobalt Wyrmworm (B–S): A tunnel-wide worm whose maw is ringed in crystal teeth. Moves: Burrow Slam, Cobalt Shell, Cave-In, Swallow Whole. Drops: B-rank Death Crystal, Cobalt shell, Refined GKOM Essence.

entries.text:
Moonstone Ravagers: Water bruisers, ranks E–A (large).

Bear-like predators that hunt by moonlight. Moonstone grows in their fur and drinks in the light around them.

Material: Moonstone claw. Found in: marsh, cave, blight, ruin.

Forms:

• Moonstone Ursine (A): An ancient bear with a pale crystal crown. Moves: Moon Maul, Lunar Roar, Crushing Hug, Tidal Swipe. Drops: A-rank Death Crystal, Moonstone claw, Refined GKOM Essence.

entries.name: Stormglass Drakes
entries.text:
Stormglass Drakes: Lightning skirmishers, ranks D–SSR (large).

Dragons that nest in lightning-struck crystal spires. A drake becomes a wyvern, and a wyvern that survives a century of storms becomes a tempest dragon.

Material: Stormglass scale. Found in: crystal, heartwood, ruin.

Forms:

• Tempest Dragon (S–SSR): A living thunderhead, its crystal scales ringing with every bolt. Moves: Storm Breath, Lightning Dive, Static Scales, Thunderclap. Drops: S-rank Death Crystal, Stormglass scale, Refined GKOM Essence.

entries.text:
Eclipse Golems: Dark bruisers, ranks C–SSR (large).

Constructs of rubble and crystal that assemble themselves around a dark orb. The largest is the blight's heart made flesh.

Material: Eclipse stone. Found in: blight.

Forms:

• Heartrot Colossus (S–SSR): The Silverwood's rotting heart, risen and walking. Moves: Eclipse Crush, Core Quake, Dark Core, Orb Beam. Drops: S-rank Death Crystal, Eclipse stone, Refined GKOM Essence.

entries.name: Gloam Oozes
entries.text:
Gloam Oozes: Water guardians, ranks F–A.

Jellies that dissolve everything but crystal. Swallowed shards drift inside them, and the oldest are cubes of living geode that fill a corridor wall to wall.

Material: Gloam gel. Found in: cave, marsh, blight.

Forms:
• Gloam Ooze (F–E): A puddle that glints with half-digested crystal. Moves: Engulf, Jelly Wobble. Drops: F-rank Death Crystal, Gloam gel, GKOM Dust. Evolves into Crystal Jelly.
• Crystal Jelly (D–C): A wobbling flan with a red orb at its centre. Moves: Engulf, Jelly Wobble, Acid Splash. Drops: D-rank Death Crystal, Gloam gel, GKOM Dust. Evolves into Geode Cube.
• Geode Cube (B): A corridor-filling cube; skeletons hang inside it. Moves: Engulf, Jelly Wobble, Acid Splash, Dissolve. Drops: B-rank Death Crystal, Gloam gel, Refined GKOM Essence. Evolves into Abyssal Gel.
• Abyssal Gel (A): A black tide that swallows light itself. Moves: Engulf, Jelly Wobble, Acid Splash, Dissolve. Drops: A-rank Death Crystal, Gloam gel, Refined GKOM Essence.

entries.name: Husks
entries.text:
Husks: Dark bruisers, ranks F–SSR.

The men GKOM killed. Husks are what is left when the infection outlives the mind: they climb the rank ladder by devouring other orbs, and the oldest remember enough to cast.

Material: Husk bone. Found in: ruin, blight, keep.

Forms:
• Hollow Husk (F–E): A shambling corpse with a grey orb where its heart was. Moves: Hollow Grasp, Rot Bite. Drops: F-rank Death Crystal, Husk bone, GKOM Dust. Evolves into Crystal Ghoul.
• Crystal Ghoul (D–C): A fast, starving husk with crystal teeth. Moves: Hollow Grasp, Rot Bite, Undying. Drops: D-rank Death Crystal, Husk bone, GKOM Dust. Evolves into Wight Knight.
• Wight Knight (B–A): A fallen soldier still wearing its rusted oath. Moves: Hollow Grasp, Rot Bite, Undying, Death Knell. Drops: B-rank Death Crystal, Husk bone, Refined GKOM Essence. Evolves into Orb Lich.
• Orb Lich (S–SSR): A husk that kept its mind; its orb floats above an open ribcage. Moves: Hollow Grasp, Rot Bite, Undying, Death Knell. Drops: S-rank Death Crystal, Husk bone, Refined GKOM Essence.

• Cathedral Gargoyle Lord (A): A gargoyle the size of a bell tower. Moves: Stone Claw, Statue Form, Swoop, Granite Cry. Drops: A-rank Death Crystal, Gargoyle grit, Refined GKOM Essence.

entries.name: Gloomshades
